data.content: * Report: Jake Bauers to Red Sox. # Rovers striker Gudjohnsen scores hat-trick for Iceland. Blackburn Rovers striker Andri Gudjohnsen scored a hat-trick as Iceland thrashed Bulgaria 5-0 in their Nations League tie in Plovdiv on Friday night. The 24-year-old opened the scoring for his country with a 17th-minute penalty before adding two more goals in the second half. The treble takes Gudjohnsen's total to 15 goals for Iceland in 44 appearances, having made his debut in 2021.
